entities.summary: Anthony Yarde is a British professional boxer. He has challenged for the world light-heavyweight championship three times; for the WBO title in 2019, unified WBC, IBF and WBO titles in 2023, and WBC and WBA (Regular) titles in 2025. At regional level, he has held multiple light-heavyweight championships, including the Commonwealth title from 2021 to 2022.
